content: सैकतिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Belonging or relating to a sand-bank. .²2 Fluctuating, wavering, living in doubt and error (संदेहजीविन्). .{@-कः@} .²1 A religious mendicant. .²2 An ascetic. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A thread worn round the wrist or neck to secure good fortune (मङ्गलसूत्र). .²2 मातृयात्रा (?).
